_comment: Per-agent model configuration (local providers deepseekmanual + minimax2). Edit freely; changes take effect on next server start (or use PUT /api/runtime/agent-models for hot reload).

presets._comment: Named aliases for experimentation. Reference with 'preset:<name>'.

notes._comment: Models resolve against the local ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json providers: deepseekmanual (api.deepseek.com) + minimax2 (api.minimaxi.com/anthropic).
notes.deepseekmanual/deepseek-v4-flash: DeepSeek V4 Flash — fast/cheap; Atlas (routing), Echo (fallback), Scout (research).
notes.minimax2/MiniMax-M3: MiniMax M3 — multimodal (image/video), strong reasoning; Forge (code), Lens (review + visual), Trainer, Analyst, Writer, Archivist.
selection_tips: Atlas (orchestrator): fast routing is enough — deepseek-v4-flash.
Forge (implementer): needs strong code gen — MiniMax-M3.
Lens (reviewer + visual): multimodal M3 — code review AND screenshot verification.
Scout (research): reads many sources fast — deepseek-v4-flash.
